question: India won the ICC Men Cricket World Cup for the first time in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1983**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India became the winner of the Cricket World Cup for the first time in 1983.
 
• The Indian cricket team, led by Kapil Dev, defeated the West Indies in the final match.
 
• The final match was held at the Lords Cricket Ground in London on 25th June 1983.
 
• This victory marked a significant milestone in Indian cricket history and inspired future generations of cricketers.
 
• The win was unexpected as the West Indies team was considered the strongest, having won the previous two World Cups.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 1983 Cricket World Cup was the third edition of the tournament.
 
• It was organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC) and was held from 9th June to 25th June 1983.
 
• A total of eight teams participated in the tournament, including India, West Indies, Australia, England, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, New Zealand, and Zimbabwe.
 
• The Indian team’s victory in 1983 played a pivotal role in popularizing cricket in India, leading to the sport's massive following in the country today.
